package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for path_param_parsing_duplicated_across_handlers: Repeated `strconv` or UUID path-param parsing logic that should live in helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func GetUserByID(c *gin.Context) {
	idStr := c.Param("id")
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(idStr)
	if err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid id"})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"user_id": id})
}

func DeleteUserByID(c *gin.Context) {
	idStr := c.Param("id")
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(idStr)
	if err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid id"})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"deleted": id})
}
